item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
People on the forum weren't too forthcoming with ways I could punch this up a little.

It's a magical suit of armor. You've done a pretty good job of fleshing it out and thankfully you avoided the ham-handedness suggested in the first post of the thread but… it's a magical suit of armor.

It's not bad, but neither is it very good. Magical items/people/fighting dudes, that's the tamest and most shopworn genre on the wiki. Punching this up would require some sort of unforeseen twist or surprise that would make this interesting enough to merit reading through everything, and if us people on the forum had that material on hand we'd be happy to offer it.

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
Good points.

I'm going to leave it a day so I can come back with fresher eyes, then try and add a little more menace. When I first had the idea, I wanted to move away from making it too aggressive, but I think I've gone too far the other way. Right now, it's just a thing. I want to make it an interesting thing.

One possible direction I may take this: making it react only to violence against people in Police uniform. Three D-Class could rape each other to death with flensing knives right in front of it, and SCP-912 wouldn't react at all. Someone patting someone in uniform on the back too hard? They get their elbow twisted up to the back of their skull.

Of course, I welcome suggestions. People on the forum weren't too forthcoming with ways I could punch this up a little.

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
1) At first I thought that the SCP was more than one full set of body armor, because of SCP-912 refers to a collection of police-issue body armour. Maybe it should say "SCP-912 refers to one complete set of police-issue body armor".

2) What does it consider to be a weapon? Can it tell the difference between a gun and a water gun? Does it consider a baseball bat to be a weapon? A butter knife?

3) Does it only care about weapons, or will (for example) vandalism get it going too?

4) Will it arrest someone if ordered to do so by a person wearing an officer's uniform? What if it's told that someone had an outstanding arrest warrant?

5) SCP-912 will attempt to disarm and secure the armed subject, and any other non-uniformed personnel in the vicinity.

Is that standard SWAT procedure? Whether it is or not should probably be noted in the description.

6) Armed attack upon SCP-912 or an unarmed subject in the vicinity will be met with potentially force using the telescopic baton.

Do you mean that if two non-uniformed people are beating each other up with their bare fists, the SCP will ignore them?
